name: video-editor
description: Turns a raw talking-head video into a finished vertical short: cuts the stumbles and long pauses, opens on a hook, adds word-by-word captions, zooms and sound, and checks the finished file before you post. Runs in Claude Cowork with nothing to install on your computer.
